sections.value: PR #152 at 253374c27943f039df593a46919ff2ecb2fb1cb1 BLOCK S152-001 MEDIUM: local machine bearer admits caller-supplied from, then successful FYI/normal send passes it to answered_by. delivery/role_send.rs:850-858 compares that string to stored holder and role_requests.rs:579-600 stamps answered_at. A different caller claiming the correct holder can FYI itself and suppress the holder request clock without controlling the holder process. Independently bind actor before stamping; honest non-holder tests do not prove this. Test correct victim from, native/shim normal/FYI, inherited-parent claims and legitimate holder controls, keeping output-answer idempotence. Cross-seat steering management is intentionally broad, but does not grant foreign answer authority. No demonstrated cold/force bypass; normal guard runs before enqueue. Source-only, exact-head CI green. Verdict: security/outputs/2026-11/07-verdict-pr-152-253374c.dd.json.
